import Base
import Tasks.Intersection
import Candidate

namespace Submission
theorem solve : Tasks.intersection :=
by
  intro G H J g h j f q hf hq
  have map_one : ∀ {A B : Type} (a : Foundation.Group A)
      (b : Foundation.Group B) (r : A → B),
      (∀ x y, r (a.mul x y) = b.mul (r x) (r y)) →
      r a.one = b.one := by
    intro A B a b r hr
    have he : r a.one = b.mul (r a.one) (r a.one) := by
      calc
        r a.one = r (a.mul a.one a.one) :=
          congrArg r (a.one_mul a.one).symm
        _ = b.mul (r a.one) (r a.one) := hr a.one a.one
    calc
      r a.one = b.mul b.one (r a.one) := (b.one_mul _).symm
      _ = b.mul (b.mul (b.inv (r a.one)) (r a.one)) (r a.one) :=
        congrArg (fun z => b.mul z (r a.one)) (b.inv_mul _).symm
      _ = b.mul (b.inv (r a.one)) (b.mul (r a.one) (r a.one)) :=
        b.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = b.mul (b.inv (r a.one)) (r a.one) :=
        congrArg (fun z => b.mul (b.inv (r a.one)) z) he.symm
      _ = b.one := b.inv_mul _
  have inv_closed : ∀ {A B : Type} (a : Foundation.Group A)
      (b : Foundation.Group B) (r : A → B)
      (hr : ∀ x y, r (a.mul x y) = b.mul (r x) (r y))
      (x : A), r x = b.one → r (a.inv x) = b.one := by
    intro A B a b r hr x hx
    calc
      r (a.inv x) = b.mul (r (a.inv x)) b.one := (b.mul_one _).symm
      _ = b.mul (r (a.inv x)) (r x) :=
        congrArg (fun z => b.mul (r (a.inv x)) z) hx.symm
      _ = r (a.mul (a.inv x) x) := (hr _ _).symm
      _ = r a.one := congrArg r (a.inv_mul x)
      _ = b.one := map_one a b r hr
  let fh : Theory.Hom g h := ⟨f, hf⟩
  let qh : Theory.Hom g j := ⟨q, hq⟩
  let k : Foundation.Group {x : G // f x = h.one ∧ q x = j.one} :=
    { one := ⟨g.one, map_one g h f hf, map_one g j q hq⟩
      mul := fun x y =>
        ⟨g.mul x.val y.val,
          Theory.kernel_mul fh x.property.1 y.property.1,
          Theory.kernel_mul qh x.property.2 y.property.2⟩
      inv := fun x =>
        ⟨g.inv x.val,
          inv_closed g h f hf x.val x.property.1,
          inv_closed g j q hq x.val x.property.2⟩
      one_mul := by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.eq
        exact g.one_mul x.val
      mul_one := by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.eq
        exact g.mul_one x.val
      mul_assoc := by
        intro x y z
        apply Subtype.eq
        exact g.mul_assoc x.val y.val z.val
      inv_mul := by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.eq
        exact g.inv_mul x.val }
  exact ⟨k, rfl, (by intro x y; rfl), (by intro x; rfl)⟩

end Submission

theorem solve : Tasks.words :=
by
  intro G H g h f hf w
  let F : Theory.Hom g h := ⟨f, hf⟩
  have map_one : f g.one = h.one := by
    have idem : h.mul (f g.one) (f g.one) = f g.one := by
      calc
        h.mul (f g.one) (f g.one) = f (g.mul g.one g.one) :=
          (hf g.one g.one).symm
        _ = f g.one := congrArg f (g.one_mul g.one)
    calc
      f g.one = h.mul h.one (f g.one) := (h.one_mul _).symm
      _ = h.mul (h.mul (h.inv (f g.one)) (f g.one)) (f g.one) :=
        congrArg (fun z => h.mul z (f g.one)) (h.inv_mul (f g.one)).symm
      _ = h.mul (h.inv (f g.one)) (h.mul (f g.one) (f g.one)) :=
        h.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = h.mul (h.inv (f g.one)) (f g.one) :=
        congrArg (fun z => h.mul (h.inv (f g.one)) z) idem
      _ = h.one := h.inv_mul _
  have inv_mem : ∀ {x : G}, f x = h.one → f (g.inv x) = h.one := by
    intro x hx
    calc
      f (g.inv x) = h.mul (f (g.inv x)) h.one := (h.mul_one _).symm
      _ = h.mul (f (g.inv x)) (f x) :=
        congrArg (fun z => h.mul (f (g.inv x)) z) hx.symm
      _ = f (g.mul (g.inv x) x) := (hf _ _).symm
      _ = f g.one := congrArg f (g.inv_mul x)
      _ = h.one := map_one
  induction w with
  | unit =>
      intro _
      exact map_one
  | atom x =>
      intro hx
      exact hx
  | product a b iha ihb =>
      intro hab
      exact Theory.kernel_mul F (iha hab.1) (ihb hab.2)
  | inverse a iha =>
      intro ha
      exact inv_mem (iha ha)

import Base

namespace Theory

structure Hom {G H : Type} (g : Foundation.Group G) (h : Foundation.Group H) where
  toFun : G → H
  map_mul : ∀ x y, toFun (g.mul x y) = h.mul (toFun x) (toFun y)

def kernel {G H : Type} {g : Foundation.Group G} {h : Foundation.Group H}
    (f : Hom g h) (x : G) : Prop :=
  f.toFun x = h.one

def Kernel {G H : Type} {g : Foundation.Group G} {h : Foundation.Group H}
    (f : Hom g h) : Type :=
  { x : G // kernel f x }

theorem kernel_mul {G H : Type} {g : Foundation.Group G} {h : Foundation.Group H}
    (f : Hom g h) {x y : G} (hx : kernel f x) (hy : kernel f y) :
    kernel f (g.mul x y) := by
  change f.toFun (g.mul x y) = h.one
  calc
    f.toFun (g.mul x y) = h.mul (f.toFun x) (f.toFun y) := f.map_mul x y
    _ = h.mul h.one (f.toFun y) := congrArg (fun z => h.mul z (f.toFun y)) hx
    _ = h.mul h.one h.one := congrArg (fun z => h.mul h.one z) hy
    _ = h.one := h.one_mul h.one

def Kernel.mul {G H : Type} {g : Foundation.Group G} {h : Foundation.Group H}
    {f : Hom g h} (x y : Kernel f) : Kernel f :=
  ⟨g.mul x.val y.val, kernel_mul f x.property y.property⟩

end Theory
